WITH p AS (SELECT f.*, s.store_id, s.format FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900),
dupl AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c FROM p GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1),
multi AS (SELECT receipt_id FROM p GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT store_id)>1 OR count(DISTINCT sale_date)>1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM dupl) dup_keys, (SELECT count(*) FROM multi) multi_receipts,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM p JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=p.sale_date WHERE NOT d.is_trading_day) nontrading_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM p JOIN ref_store_closure c ON c.store_id=p.store_id AND p.sale_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) closure_lines,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT store_id) FROM p) stores,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM p WHERE abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02) vat_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM p WHERE net_amount>2000) big_lines,
 (SELECT max(net_amount) FROM p) maxline,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM p WHERE member_key IS NULL) nonmember_lines

calls.statement:
WITH p AS (SELECT f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, s.store_id, s.format FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900),
m AS (SELECT store_id, format, count(DISTINCT sale_date) n_days, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) n_receipts, sum(net_amount) net FROM p GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT store_id, count(DISTINCT business_date) r_days, sum(receipts) r_receipts, sum(net_sales_before_returns) r_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.format, count(*) stores, min(n_days) mind, max(n_days) maxd, sum(m.n_receipts) receipts, sum(r.r_receipts) rpt_receipts, round(sum(m.net),2) net, round(sum(r.r_net),2) rpt_net, sum(CASE WHEN m.n_days<>r.r_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) day_mismatch_stores
FROM m LEFT JOIN r USING(store_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, s.format
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 AND s.store_id < 900
),
staff_receipts AS (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_id FROM p WHERE staff_purchase_flag)
SELECT format,
  round(sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM staff_receipts)) / count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM staff_receipts)), 2) AS avg_transaction_value_eur,
  round(sum(net_amount) / count(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv_incl_staff,
  count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM staff_receipts)) AS n_receipts
FROM p GROUP BY format ORDER BY CASE format WHEN 'Large' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
